notes: R1-3 (fix round after the four-role tests, decision A20): the corrected storage headroom gives each power battery type (0.25C, 0.5C, 1C) its own cap of expansion.storage_cap_fraction x power_room (0.2 by default), as in the thesis design: the three serve different durations and the fraction is already a reduced share. This withdraws the shared power-battery pool of P0-7 S7 (p07.power-battery-pool, finding P5-02), which stays in the catalogue so that the identity of Runs made between P0-7 and R1-3 remains readable; the corrected profile applies both corrections and r13 takes precedence. The P5-01 headroom fix (p07.storage-leftover-headroom) is kept.

A method change of the corrected profile only (Q13: saved Studies need explicit confirmation); the doctoral reproduction profile keeps the 35aadb3 per-type caps (Q1), so it has no advisory for this correction.

corrections.description: value-corrected: on the post-charge leftover headroom (p07.storage-leftover-headroom) each power battery type (0.25C, 0.5C, 1C) has its own cap of cap_fraction x power_room, so together they may take up to three times that room (the thesis design, decision A20); the hydrogen battery keeps cap_fraction x the seasonal room. The headroom row declares no shared pool and agent-investment caps each type separately. Withdraws the shared pool of p07.power-battery-pool (P5-02 as read by P0-7 S7); the doctoral profile has per-type caps already (Q1).
